name: The North Berwick Coven
summary: A massive gathering accused of using high-seas weather magic to target royal shipping.
lore: Over 70 people were accused of assembling at the ruined St Andrew's Auld Kirk on the Scottish coast. Led by a respected local midwife and healer named Agnes Sampson and a schoolmaster named John Fian, the circle was accused of brewing storms by drowning cats in sea-water to sink the ship carrying King James VI and his bride, Anne of Denmark. King James became so terrified by the trial details that he personally interrogated suspects and authored Daemonologie, his famous book on hunting witches.

events.title: A Storm Over the Forth
events.narrative: A great ship is seen beating up the Firth of Forth against a rising gale. Your sea-witches say they could drown it with a cat in saltwater — but it may be the King's own vessel.

choiceA.label: Brew the storm and sink it
choiceA.description: +25% Faith if it sinks, −8 Followers if the King's ship

random.winMessage: The ship founders and sinks with all hands. Word of your power over the sea spreads across Lothian. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: It was the King's ship, and it survived. The crown's wrath falls on the coast; eight of your number flee. −8 Followers.

choiceB.label: Let it pass and preach calm

events.title: The Haddington Storm-Callers
events.narrative: The weather-witches of Haddington have been brewing tempests in copper cauldrons and selling fair winds to merchants — undercutting your coven's influence over the coast.

events.title: The Dunbar Sea-Witches' Fog
events.narrative: The harbor hags of Dunbar have sent a thick fog to wreck ships on the rocks and loot the drowned. But the latest wreck carried a nobleman, and questions are being asked.

choiceA.label: Help them hide the wreck's spoils

events.title: The Prestonpans Salt-Sorcerers
events.narrative: The salt-pan workers of Prestonpans have been scrying in crystallized seawater and claim to have seen your coven's faces in the brine. They threaten to carry the vision to the Kirk.

events.title: Agnes Sampson's Interrogation
events.narrative: The wise woman Agnes Sampson has been taken to Holyrood for questioning by the King himself. The coven gathers in fear — what will she say under the witch-bridle?

choiceB.label: Pray she holds her tongue
choiceB.description: +15% Faith if she resists, −6 Followers if she names names

random.winMessage: Agnes says nothing of use. The King is frustrated, and the coven endures. +15% Faith.
random.lossMessage: Under the bridle she names six of your number. They must run or be taken. −6 Followers.

events.title: The King's Daemonologie
events.narrative: King James has begun writing a book on hunting witches, using your coven's alleged deeds as his chief examples. Copies will spread across Scotland.

choiceB.label: Go to ground until it passes

events.title: The Auld Kirk Assembly
events.narrative: Tonight the coven assembles at the ruined St Andrew's Auld Kirk, as they did before. But a spy is rumored among the worshippers.

choiceA.label: Hold the assembly and root out the spy
choiceA.description: +20% Faith if found, −5 Followers if not

random.winMessage: You catch a friar taking notes and bind him to silence. The assembly swears new oaths. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: You find no spy, but the fear itself splits the coven. Five drift away into the night. −5 Followers.

choiceB.label: Cancel and meet in smaller circles

events.title: The Drowned Cat Rite
events.narrative: A great rite is proposed: drown a black cat in seawater at the kirk to raise a tempest against a fleet of warships. It is old, powerful, and terrible.

events.title: A Lothian Noble's Patronage
events.narrative: A nobleman arrives at the kirk ruins with a heavy purse. 'My ships are becalmed. I am told your coven commands the winds. Name your price.'

events.title: The Midwife's Apprentice
events.narrative: A young woman from a fishing village seeks out the coven. 'I have the sight. I delivered a babe last moon and saw his fate in the caul. I would learn your craft.'

choiceB.label: Take her silver for the teaching
